mixture_1.title: Mixture 1
mixture_1.description:

+ TPA saturated-solution clear supernatant (6 mL)
mixture_1.model_basis: solubility-limited effective dissolved concentrations for pHBA and TPA; nominal concentrations for acetic acid and SSA
